title: Chicken Noodle Soup
description: A hearty, comforting chicken soup with vegetables and noodles - perfect for cold days or when you're feeling under the weather.
steps: In a large pot, place chicken and cover with water. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 1 hour.
Remove chicken, let cool, then shred meat and discard bones.
In the same pot, add carrots, celery, onion, garlic, bay leaves, and thyme. Simmer for 15 minutes.
Add shredded chicken and egg noodles. Cook until noodles are tender, about 8-10 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper. Garnish with fresh parsley before serving.

title: Classic Chocolate Chip Cookies
description: The perfect chocolate chip cookies - crispy on the outside, chewy on the inside, and loaded with chocolate chips.
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Line baking sheets with parchment paper.
In a small bowl, whisk together flour, baking soda, and salt.
In a large bowl, beat butter and sugars until creamy. Add eggs one at a time, then vanilla.
Gradually mix in the flour mixture, then fold in chocolate chips.
Drop rounded tablespoons of dough onto baking sheets, spacing 2 inches apart.
Bake for 9-11 minutes or until golden brown. Cool on baking sheets for 2 minutes, then transfer to wire racks.

title: Spaghetti Bolognese
description: A rich and flavorful meat sauce served over al dente spaghetti - a classic Italian comfort food that's always a crowd-pleaser.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add onion, carrots, and celery, and cook until softened, about 5-7 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for another minute.
Increase heat to medium-high and add ground beef. Cook until browned, breaking up the meat with a spoon.
Stir in tomato paste and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Add crushed tomatoes, beef broth, wine (if using), oregano, basil, and bay leaves. Bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, uncovered, for at least 30 minutes (or up to 2 hours for deeper flavor), stirring occasionally.
Meanwhile, cook spaghetti according to package directions until al dente.
Serve sauce over drained spaghetti. Top with grated Parmesan and fresh basil.

title: Grilled Chicken Salad
description: A fresh and healthy salad featuring perfectly grilled chicken, crisp vegetables, and a tangy vinaigrette dressing.
steps: Rub chicken breasts with 1 tablespoon olive oil and Italian seasoning. Season with salt and pepper.
Grill chicken over medium-high heat for 6-7 minutes per side, or until internal temperature reaches 165°F (74°C).
Let chicken rest for 5 minutes, then slice.
In a large bowl, combine salad greens, tomatoes, cucumber, red onion, and avocado.
In a small bowl, whisk together dressing ingredients.
Toss salad with dressing, top with sliced chicken and feta cheese.
Serve immediately.

title: Homemade Pizza
description: Create your own pizza at home with a perfectly crispy crust, savory sauce, and your favorite toppings.
ingredients: 2 tablespoons olive oil, plus more for coating
Additional toppings as desired (pepperoni, vegetables, etc.)
steps: For the dough: In a large bowl, combine flour, sugar, yeast, and salt. Add warm water and olive oil, stir until a dough forms.
Knead on a floured surface for 5-7 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Place in an oiled bowl, cover, and let rise in a warm place for 1 hour or until doubled in size.
For the sauce: In a small saucepan, heat olive oil over medium heat. Add garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Add tomato sauce and herbs, simmer for 10 minutes.
Preheat oven to 475°F (245°C). If you have a pizza stone, place it in the oven to preheat.
Punch down dough and divide in half (for two 12-inch pizzas). Roll each portion into a circle on a floured surface.
Place dough on a pizza peel or baking sheet dusted with cornmeal.
Spread sauce over dough, leaving a 1-inch border. Top with cheeses and desired toppings.
Bake for 12-15 minutes or until crust is golden and cheese is bubbly.
Let cool slightly before slicing and serving.

title: Beef Stir Fry
description: A quick and flavorful stir fry with tender beef strips, colorful vegetables, and a savory sauce - ready in under 30 minutes.
ingredients: 1 pound flank steak, thinly sliced against the grain
Sliced green onions and sesame seeds for garnish
steps: In a bowl, mix all sauce ingredients until well combined. Set aside.
Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a large wok or skillet over high heat. Add beef and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes until browned but not fully cooked. Remove and set aside.
Add remaining oil to the wok. Add garlic and ginger, stir-fry for 30 seconds.
Add vegetables and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes until crisp-tender.
Return beef to the wok. Pour sauce over and bring to a simmer, stirring constantly.
Cook for 1-2 minutes until sauce thickens and beef is cooked through.
Serve over rice, garnished with green onions and sesame seeds.

title: Banana Bread
description: Moist and delicious banana bread packed with banana flavor and optionally studded with nuts or chocolate chips.
ingredients: 1/2 cup chopped walnuts or chocolate chips (optional)
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease a 4x8-inch loaf pan.
In a mixing bowl, mash the ripe bananas with a fork until smooth.
Stir the melted butter into the mashed bananas.
Mix in the baking soda and salt.
Stir in the sugar, beaten egg, and vanilla extract.
Fold in the flour, being careful not to overmix.
Fold in walnuts or chocolate chips if using.
Pour the batter into the prepared loaf pan.
Bake for 50-60 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
Let cool in the pan for 10 minutes, then remove to a wire rack to cool completely before slicing.

title: Chicken Tikka Masala
description: A popular Indian dish featuring tender chunks of chicken in a creamy, spiced tomato sauce, perfect with rice or naan bread.
ingredients: 2 pounds boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cut into bite-sized pieces
steps: In a large bowl, combine all marinade ingredients. Add chicken and toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour, preferably overnight.
Preheat oven to 500°F (260°C). Line a baking sheet with foil.
Place marinated chicken on the baking sheet and bake for 10-12 minutes until edges are slightly charred.
Meanwhile, heat oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and ginger, cook for 1 minute.
Add cumin, coriander, and paprika. Cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Stir in crushed tomatoes. Bring to a simmer and cook for 5 minutes.
Add cream and butter, stir until incorporated.
Add the baked chicken to the sauce and simmer for 5 minutes.
Garnish with cilantro and serve with rice and naan.

title: Guacamole
description: Fresh, creamy guacamole with just the right amount of lime and spice - perfect for dipping chips or topping Mexican dishes.
steps: Cut avocados in half, remove pits, and scoop flesh into a bowl.
Mash avocados with a fork, leaving some chunks for texture.
Add lime juice and salt, mix well.
Stir in remaining ingredients, combining gently.
Taste and adjust seasoning if needed.
Serve immediately with tortilla chips or cover with plastic wrap pressed directly onto the surface to prevent browning if serving later.

title: Apple Pie
description: A classic American dessert featuring a flaky crust filled with cinnamon-spiced apples - delicious warm with a scoop of vanilla ice cream.
ingredients: 1 cup cold unsalted butter, cut into cubes
6-7 large apples (Granny Smith or a mix of varieties), peeled, cored, and sliced
2 tablespoons unsalted butter, cut into small pieces
1 egg, beaten with 1 tablespoon water (for egg wash)
steps: For the crust: In a food processor, pulse flour, salt, and sugar. Add butter and pulse until mixture resembles coarse meal.
Add ice water a tablespoon at a time, pulsing until dough just comes together.
Divide dough in half, shape into disks, wrap in plastic, and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C).
In a large bowl, toss apple slices with sugar, flour, cinnamon, nutmeg, salt, and lemon juice.
Roll out one disk of dough on a floured surface to fit a 9-inch pie dish. Place in the dish, letting excess hang over the edge.
Fill with apple mixture. Dot with butter pieces.
Roll out the second disk of dough and place over filling. Trim excess dough, crimp edges to seal, and cut slits in the top crust for venting.
Brush with egg wash and sprinkle with additional sugar if desired.
Bake for 20 minutes, then reduce temperature to 375°F (190°C) and continue baking for 30-40 minutes until crust is golden and filling is bubbly.
Cool on a wire rack before serving.
